what: A black pill with half-moon, dot and small-dot echoes (15.26·8.01·3.23px) on both sides. On hover, the echoes fold into the pill from the outermost in at 84·42·0ms (width 0, .28s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)) and the pill widens by that much. The label rolls letter by letter at 15ms intervals, 150% upward, and is replaced by the same letter coming up from below (.45s cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1)). On press, the pill squeezes back to its original width.

options.--fx-h · --fx-pad · --fx-side: Button height 40px · side padding of the text box 32px · echo group width 30.5px
options.--fx-bg · --fx-ink: Pill and echo color (default text color) · text color on the pill (default background color). Swap them on dark sections
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Button label. On attach it splits the text into two sets of letters, and on detach it restores the original text

note: Echo fold and letter roll run on CSS transition, so they work without GSAP. On touch devices it stays in its resting shape
